title: Fix Launch backend preflight aggregation
summary: Limit Launch backend preflight aggregation to active launch targets so an unstaged CSV rerun path does not make normal Pipeline preflight look blocked.
reason: The Launch readiness panel refreshed Pipeline plus CSV rerun start/preview preflights every time. With no CSV path staged, both rerun preflights correctly returned blocked and the combined Backend Preflight status showed Blocked even when Pipeline preflight itself was startable.
behavior_before: Refreshing Launch Backend Preflight with no CSV path staged requested Pipeline, CSV Rerun Start, and CSV Rerun Preview; the empty rerun CSV path blockers could dominate the combined status.
behavior_after: Refreshing Launch Backend Preflight always requests Pipeline and requests CSV Rerun Start/Preview only when a CSV path is staged; normal Pipeline readiness is no longer blocked by inactive rerun controls.
manual_validation: In-app Browser against temporary Local API on 127.0.0.1:16525 - Launch > Readiness > Refresh Backend Preflight rendered Status: Review, Targets: 1, blocked=0, requested=1, and only Pipeline rows when no CSV path was staged
